stories.title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade

sources.title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade

sources.title_original: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
sources.summary: Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor project has run into an unexpected trademark dispute with Tera-print, a small U.S. company that has used the Tera-Fab name for its tabletop lithography equipment for about a decade.
sources.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Terafab 半导体项目与 Tera-print 发生了一场意想不到的商标纠纷，Tera-print 是一家美国小公司，该公司在其桌面光刻设备上使用 Tera-Fab 名称已有大约十年的时间。
